translations.web: Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.
translations.bsb: Go, eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a cheerful heart, for God has already approved your works:
translations.kjv: Go thy way, eat thy bread with joy, and drink thy wine with a merry heart; for God now accepteth thy works.
translations.asv: Go thy way, eat thy bread with joy, and drink thy wine with a merry heart; for God hath already accepted thy works.
